sources.snippet: DEEPX builds high-efficiency Neural Processing Units (NPUs) and the full software toolchain around them. Our open-source stack, DXNN® (DX-AllSuite), streamlines the entire journey — from an ONNX or PyTorch model to a real-world "Physical AI" application running on a DEEPX NPU — through a single, version-aligned toolchain covering compilation, optimization, and deployment.
